description: Get a single published Community Days event by its URL slug, with its page text (home_content), each tab's text (sessions_content, speakers_content, sponsors_content, schedule_content, as HTML) and its venue maps (venue_maps), which search_events and list_events leave out. Each event's last_update is when its own team last changed it, or its status last changed (sent for approval, published, cancelled and the like); a fix by a Community Days administrator doesn't move it. Older events may have no last_update, or one a few hours off. Each event's social_links are its own links: each has a platform (such as x, linkedin, meetup or youtube) and a handle, the end of the page's address after the site name; for blog, website and newsletter the handle is the full web address. A newsletter link is the event's newsletter, which people can subscribe to.

slug.description: Event URL slug (the slug returned by search_events), or a link to the event's page

name: get_event
